name: app-health-score-phone-on-white-plinths-with-black-disc
title: Health Score Phone on White Plinths
whatItIs: A grey rounded panel with a phone tilted across a white block and cylinder, next to a black disc, showing a light blue 92% health score, a sunburst graphic and four metric cards (calories, water, sleep, heart rate).
whatItMeans: Simple geometric blocks in white and grey with one black disc give a calm, gallery-like stage.
techniques: White blocks and cylinders as a stage
One black disc as the contrast
Phone leaning against a block at an angle
Light blue gradient inside the UI

vocabulary.definition: Simple solids used as props in a product scene.
A single dark shape balancing a pale scene.
Radiating lines drawn like a rising sun.
